system.description:
Reaching into a subject's subconscious, you take on the semblance of the one person they trust above all others - a friend, a relative, even someone long dead.

Spend a Willpower Trait and make a Mental Challenge against the subject. On a success they believe you to be a trusted intimate, and you gain three extra Traits to all Subterfuge tests while the power is in effect. Old Friend affects only one subject at a time, and onlookers see your true features unless you also use Mask of a Thousand Faces. The impersonated person need not even be alive; the subject remembers the encounter as a dream or ghostly visitation.
